timing: toxic adds a damage result only after creature combat damage to a player
choices: affected player orders applicable poison-counter replacements
apnap: simultaneous affected players are prepared in APNAP order
layers: ability-adding and ability-removing effects determine the source's total toxic value
replacement_effects: the poison-counter result remains replaceable before atomic commit
copy: copiable characteristics may supply fixed toxic values
control_change: the damage source controller places the resulting counters
zone_change: source last-known information is required after an unrepresented zone change
source_leaves: represented source snapshots retain controller, type, and toxic facts

known_blockers: dynamic or otherwise unresolved toxic values remain fail-closed
unrepresented source last-known-information and continuous ability grants remain fail-closed
the complete counter-replacement Oracle family is not yet compiled
